# Solved-network fixture

`v1-sample.nc` is a 13-bus subnetwork extracted from the historical v1 solved
network for 17 July 2013, available in Git history. It preserves line `11274`,
link `T22`, buses `5624`, `1004`, `1005`, their endpoints and the first six buses,
including a negative-load node. Tests use this checked-in fixture without loading
the full network.
